notion:richTextSpanText.label: Rich-text span text
notion:richTextSpanText.description: Extract the displayed (de-styled) text of a single RichText span. Map this over a [RichText] to recover the plain text of a paragraph / heading.

notion:retrievePage.label: Retrieve page
notion:retrievePage.description: Fetch a page by id. Returns the page with its property values.

notion:createPage.label: Create page
notion:createPage.description: Create a new page under a parent page or database. `properties` carries column values when the parent is a database; otherwise pass `[]`.

notion:updatePage.label: Update page
notion:updatePage.description: Patch a page's properties / icon / cover / archived state. Pass an empty `properties` list to leave columns untouched.

notion:retrieveDatabase.label: Retrieve database
notion:retrieveDatabase.description: Fetch a database by id, including its property schema.

notion:queryDatabase.label: Query database
notion:queryDatabase.description: Query a database's rows (pages). Pass `Nothing` for filter to return all rows. `pageSize` caps at 100 server-side.

notion:retrieveBlock.label: Retrieve block
notion:retrieveBlock.description: Fetch a single block by id. Children are NOT inline — call retrieveBlockChildren.

notion:retrieveBlockChildren.label: Retrieve block children
notion:retrieveBlockChildren.description: Fetch the children of a block (or of a page — pages are blocks too). Paginated; `pageSize` caps at 100.

notion:appendBlockChildren.label: Append block children
notion:appendBlockChildren.description: Append blocks to the children of `blockId`. Pass `after` to insert after a specific existing child block; otherwise blocks are appended at the end.

notion:updateBlock.label: Update block
notion:updateBlock.description: Replace a block's content. The new content must be the same block kind as the existing block.

notion:deleteBlock.label: Delete block
notion:deleteBlock.description: Move a block to the trash. Notion soft-deletes — the returned block has `inTrash = true`.

notion:retrieveUser.label: Retrieve user
notion:retrieveUser.description: Fetch a workspace user by id.

notion:listUsers.label: List users
notion:listUsers.description: Page through all users in the workspace. `pageSize` caps at 100.

notion:retrieveMe.label: Retrieve token bot
notion:retrieveMe.description: Fetch the bot user that owns the integration token.

notion:createComment.label: Create comment
notion:createComment.description: Post a comment. Use CommentOnPage to start a new discussion on a page; CommentOnDiscussion to reply to an existing thread.

notion:retrieveComments.label: Retrieve comments
notion:retrieveComments.description: Fetch comments attached to a page or block.

notion:search.label: Search
notion:search.description: Workspace-wide search for pages and databases the integration has access to. Pass `Nothing` for query to list everything.

notion:encodeTimestampField.label: notion-codec: encodeTimestampField

notion:decodeNotionDate.label: notion-codec: decodeNotionDate

notion:decodeParent.label: notion-codec: decodeParent
notion:decodeParent.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2a — decode a Notion parent record (wire shape: { type: "page_id" | "database_id" | "block_id" | "workspace", <id_field>: String }) to a Parent variant. 4-arm case-of on `w.type` with `WorkspaceParent` fallback; the wrapper pre-extracts the 3 id fields as strings TS-side. notion:encodeParent.label: notion-codec: encodeParent

notion:decodeCommentParent.label: notion-codec: decodeCommentParent
notion:decodeCommentParent.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2a — decode a Notion CommentParent record to a CommentParent variant. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:257.

notion:encodeCommentParent.label: notion-codec: encodeCommentParent
notion:encodeCommentParent.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2a — encode a CommentParent variant to the Notion wire-shape record. 2-arm case-of emitting { discussion_id } or { page_id }. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeCommentParent`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:265.

notion:decodeNotionFile.label: notion-codec: decodeNotionFile
notion:decodeNotionFile.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2a — decode a Notion file record to a NotionFile variant (ExternalFile | UploadedFile). 2-arm case-of on `w.type`. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeNotionFile`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:279.

notion:encodeNotionFile.label: notion-codec: encodeNotionFile
notion:encodeNotionFile.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2a — encode a NotionFile variant to the Notion wire-shape record. 2-arm case-of with each arm emitting { type, <wrapper-key>: { url } } (Notion's write API only accepts URL on writes — expiry_time is server-side-managed). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeNotionFile`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:298.

notion:decodeIcon.label: notion-codec: decodeIcon
notion:decodeIcon.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2a — decode a Notion icon record to an Icon variant (EmojiIcon | ExternalIcon | UploadedIcon). 3-arm case-of on `w.type`. The wrapper pre-resolves the wire's nested url + emoji + expiry_time TS-side. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeIcon`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:317.

notion:encodeIcon.label: notion-codec: encodeIcon
notion:encodeIcon.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2a — encode an Icon variant to the Notion wire-shape record. 3-arm case-of: EmojiIcon → { type: "emoji", emoji }; ExternalIcon → { type: "external", external: { url } }; UploadedIcon → { type: "file", file: { url } }. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeIcon`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:338.

notion:decodeCover.label: notion-codec: decodeCover
notion:decodeCover.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2a — decode a Notion cover record to a Cover variant (ExternalCover | UploadedCover). 2-arm case-of on `w.type`. The wrapper pre-resolves the wire's nested url + expiry_time TS-side. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeCover`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:351.

notion:encodeCover.label: notion-codec: encodeCover
notion:encodeCover.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2a — encode a Cover variant to the Notion wire-shape record. 2-arm case-of: ExternalCover → { type: "external", external: { url } }; UploadedCover → { type: "file", file: { url } }. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeCover`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:365.

notion:decodeBotOwner.label: notion-codec: decodeBotOwner
notion:decodeBotOwner.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — decode a Notion bot-owner record (wire shape: { type: "user" | "workspace", user: { id } }) to a BotOwner variant. 2-arm case-of on `w.type` with `WorkspaceOwner` fallback. The wrapper pre-extracts the nested user.id TS-side. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeBotOwner`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:272.

notion:decodeBotInfo.label: notion-codec: decodeBotInfo
notion:decodeBotInfo.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — decode a Notion bot-info record (the `bot` field of a bot user) to a BotInfo value. The wrapper pre-classifies `has_owner: Bool` from field presence + pre-shapes the owner_input record + Maybe-wraps workspace_name. The body's if-then-else conditionally calls `decodeBotOwner` via bare-ident + wraps in Just/Nothing for the Maybe<BotOwner> field. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeBotInfo`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:281.

notion:decodeNotionUser.label: notion-codec: decodeNotionUser
notion:decodeNotionUser.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — decode a Notion user record to a NotionUser variant (PersonUser | BotUser | PartialUser). 3-arm case-of on `w.type` ("person" / "bot" / fallback PartialUser). The wrapper recursively pre-shapes the bot_input record for the BotUser arm so the body's bare-ident `decodeBotInfo` call resolves. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeNotionUser`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:291.

notion:decodeTemplateMention.label: notion-codec: decodeTemplateMention
notion:decodeTemplateMention.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — decode a Notion template-mention record to a TemplateMention variant. 2-arm case-of on `w.type` ("template_mention_user" -> TemplateMentionUser; default -> TemplateMentionDate). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeTemplateMention`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:324.

notion:decodeMention.label: notion-codec: decodeMention
notion:decodeMention.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — decode a Notion mention record to a Mention variant. 7-arm case-of on `w.type`. The wrapper recursively pre-shapes nested user_input / date_input / template_input records so the body's bare-ident `decodeNotionUser` / `decodeNotionDate` / `decodeTemplateMention` calls resolve. LinkPreviewMention is inline-constructed (single-field; no separate decoder). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeMention`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:332.

notion:encodeMention.label: notion-codec: encodeMention
notion:encodeMention.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — encode a Mention variant to the Notion wire-shape record. 7-arm case-of: each arm destructures the variant + emits the wire shape. UserMention reads `u.id` directly (all NotionUser variants share an `id` field). DateMention emits `date = encodeNotionDate d`, which produces a sub-record with Maybe<String> fields; the wrapper post-processes to omit-when-Nothing for end / time_zone. TemplateMentionM emits an opaque `template_mention: {}` (matches TS oracle's lossy round-trip). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeMention`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:367.

notion:decodeRichText.label: notion-codec: decodeRichText
notion:decodeRichText.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — decode a Notion rich-text span record to a RichText variant. 3-arm case-of on `w.type` ("mention" / "equation" / default "text"). The wrapper recursively pre-shapes the annotations_input + mention_input records so the body's bare-ident `decodeAnnotations` / `decodeMention` calls resolve. Each arm shares annotations / plainText / href (the body repeats the field bindings rather than factoring via let — local readability over DRY at this scale). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeRichText`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:391.

notion:encodeRichText.label: notion-codec: encodeRichText
notion:encodeRichText.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — encode a RichText variant to the Notion wire-shape record. 3-arm case-of. Each arm calls `encodeAnnotations a` via bare-ident (output passes through wrapper unchanged — no Maybe fields in Annotations). The body emits Maybe<String> for href + (RichTextText only) text.link; the wrapper post-processes: href Maybe → omit-when-Nothing; link Maybe → JS `null` for Nothing / `{ url }` for Just. For RichTextMention, the embedded mention is recursively finalized (in particular DateMention's date sub-record). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeRichText`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:431.

notion:decodeSelectOption.label: notion-codec: decodeSelectOption
notion:decodeSelectOption.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — decode a Notion select-option record (id / name / color / description) to a SelectOption value. Single-arm body constructing the variant + recursively calling `decodeColor` for the color field. description is Maybe<String> from the wrapper. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeSelectOption`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:479.

notion:decodeStatusGroup.label: notion-codec: decodeStatusGroup
notion:decodeStatusGroup.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — decode a Notion status-group record (id / name / color / optionIds) to a StatusGroup value. Single-arm body constructing the variant. optionIds is List<String> pre-decoded by the wrapper. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeStatusGroup`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:490.

notion:decodeFileRef.label: notion-codec: decodeFileRef
notion:decodeFileRef.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — decode a Notion file-ref record (name + merged NotionFile wire shape) to a FileRef value. The wrapper pre-shapes the file_input record so the body's bare-ident `decodeNotionFile` call resolves; the name field passes through directly. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeFileRef`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:505.

notion:encodeFileRef.label: notion-codec: encodeFileRef
notion:encodeFileRef.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — encode a FileRef value to the Notion wire-shape record (name + merged NotionFile wire fields at top level). 2-arm case-of on the inner NotionFile variant via NESTED named-field destructuring (`FileRef { name = n, file = ExternalFile { url = u } }`). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeFileRef`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:514.

notion:decodeFormulaResult.label: notion-codec: decodeFormulaResult
notion:decodeFormulaResult.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — decode a Notion formula-result record to a FormulaResult variant. 4-arm case-of on `w.type`. The wrapper pre-Maybe-wraps the primitive values (string / number / boolean) + pre-decodes the date variant TS-side via dispatchedDecodeNotionDate + Maybe-wraps (cleaner than a body if-then-else over a wrapper-set Bool for Just vs Nothing construction). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeFormulaResult`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:520.

notion:decodeRollupResult.label: notion-codec: decodeRollupResult
notion:decodeRollupResult.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — decode a Notion rollup-result record to a RollupResult variant. 5-arm case-of on `w.type`. NumberRollup / DateRollup follow the same wrapper-pre-decode pattern as FormulaResult. ArrayRollup contains a List<PropertyValue>; the wrapper pre-decodes each element TS-side via the still-TS decodePropertyValue shim (CROSS-SUB-STEP CARVE-OUT pending sub-step 2c — when notion:decodePropertyValue is registered, the wrapper can drop the TS-side pre-decoding). IncompleteRollup / UnsupportedRollup are nullary. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeRollupResult`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:544.

notion:decodeRelationRef.label: notion-codec: decodeRelationRef
notion:decodeRelationRef.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2b — decode a Notion relation-ref record (single id field) to a RelationRef value. Degenerate body — single-field record construction. Same surface-visibility justification as 2a's NotionDate (matrix-visible + Fenel-callable, despite minimal genuine reasoning content). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeRelationRef`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:567.

notion:decodePropertyValue.label: notion-codec: decodePropertyValue
notion:decodePropertyValue.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2c — decode a Notion property-value record to a PropertyValue variant (the most-used Notion type). 24-arm case-of on `w.type`. The wrapper recursively pre-decodes every nested value TS-side: [RichText] (title / rich_text), Maybe<SelectOption> (select / status), [SelectOption] (multi_select), Maybe<NotionDate> (date), [NotionUser] (people), [FileRef] (files), FormulaResult (formula), [RelationRef] (relation), RollupResult (rollup), NotionUser (created_by / last_edited_by), Maybe<NotionUser> + Maybe<NotionDate> (verification), Maybe<Number> + Maybe<String> (unique_id), Maybe<String> (url / email / phone_number). The body reads pre-decoded fields + constructs the typed variant via the construct op. Default arm emits UnsupportedValue with the raw type string. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodePropertyValue`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:367.

notion:decodePropertiesObject.label: notion-codec: decodePropertiesObject
notion:decodePropertiesObject.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2c — convert Notion's `{ propName: propValue }` JS object form into a typed [PropertyEntry] list. The wrapper walks Object.entries TS-side + pre-decodes each propValue via dispatchedDecodePropertyValue + passes a list of `{ name, value }` records to the body. The body uses std:map + an inline lambda to wrap each pre-shaped entry into a PropertyEntry constructor. Dynamic-key object walks stay TS-side because Fenel record literals require static keys; typed-list construction is natural Fenel. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodePropertiesObject`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:549.

notion:encodePropertyWrite.label: notion-codec: encodePropertyWrite
notion:encodePropertyWrite.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2c — encode a PropertyWrite variant to the Notion wire-shape record. 14-arm case-of on the Fenel value's tag. The body destructures each variant + emits a flat marker record `{ _wkind = "<VariantName>", ...raw_payload_fields }` (multi-field — avoids the single-key `{ id = X }` codeName clash). The wrapper switches on `_wkind` + builds the wire shape with per-arm transformations: list-element encoding via dispatchedEncodeRichText / dispatchedEncodeFileRef (TitleWrite / RichTextWrite / FilesWrite), Maybe → null|value finalization (NumberWrite / UrlWrite / EmailWrite / PhoneNumberWrite), Maybe<String> → { name } (SelectWrite / StatusWrite), Maybe<NotionDate> → encoded date or null (DateWrite), [String] → [{name: x}] (MultiSelectWrite), [String] → [{object: "user", id: x}] (PeopleWrite), [String] → [{id: x}] (RelationWrite). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodePropertyWrite`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:475.

notion:decodeRelationKind.label: notion-codec: decodeRelationKind
notion:decodeRelationKind.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2c — decode a Notion relation-property `kind` sub-record to a RelationKind variant (SinglePropertyRelation | DualPropertyRelation). 2-arm case-of on `w.type` ("dual_property" -> DualPropertyRelation with the 2 synced-property ids; default -> SinglePropertyRelation). The wrapper pre-extracts the synced-property strings TS-side. Broken out as a separate fnId per the 2a/2b precedent for small dispatch helpers (matrix visibility + Fenel-callability). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeRelationKind`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:562.

notion:decodeProperty.label: notion-codec: decodeProperty
notion:decodeProperty.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2c — decode a Notion property (database schema) record to a Property variant. 24-arm case-of on `w.type`. Most arms are degenerate (id + name only); the wrapper pre-shapes the richer arms — [SelectOption] for select/multi_select/status options, [StatusGroup] for status groups, RelationKind for relation (pre-computed via dispatchedDecodeRelationKind), 5 strings for rollup, Maybe<String> for unique_id prefix, the format string for number. Default arm emits RichTextProperty as catch-all (matches TS oracle). The TS oracle factors "select" + "multi_select" into a shared branch with inline tag dispatch; the Fenel body uses separate arms (each emitting the appropriate constructor) — the natural Fenel translation. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeProperty`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:575.

notion:decodePropertySchemaObject.label: notion-codec: decodePropertySchemaObject
notion:decodePropertySchemaObject.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2c — convert Notion's `{ propName: propertyDef }` JS object form (database schema) into a typed [PropertySchemaEntry] list. Same recipe as decodePropertiesObject: wrapper walks Object.entries TS-side + pre-decodes each propertyDef via dispatchedDecodeProperty; body uses std:map + lambda to wrap each pre-shaped `{ name, property }` into a PropertySchemaEntry constructor. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodePropertySchemaObject`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:673.

notion:decodeLinkTarget.label: notion-codec: decodeLinkTarget
notion:decodeLinkTarget.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2d — decode a Notion link-target record (used by LinkToPageContent) to a LinkTarget variant. 2-arm case-of on `w.type` ("database_id" -> DatabaseIdTarget; default -> PageIdTarget). The wrapper pre-extracts type + database_id + page_id as strings TS-side. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeLinkTarget`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:408.

notion:encodeLinkTarget.label: notion-codec: encodeLinkTarget
notion:encodeLinkTarget.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2d — encode a LinkTarget variant to the Notion wire-shape record. 2-arm case-of: DatabaseIdTarget emits `{ type = "database_id", database_id = d }`; PageIdTarget emits `{ type = "page_id", page_id = p }`. Body emits the snake_case wire shape directly via record literal (multi-field — safe from {id=X} codeName clash). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeLinkTarget`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:416.

notion:decodeBlockContent.label: notion-codec: decodeBlockContent
notion:decodeBlockContent.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2d — decode a Notion block-content record to a BlockContent variant (the biggest single body in the codec series). 33-arm case-of on `w.type` covering paragraph + 3 headings + 2 list items + to_do + toggle + code + callout + quote + equation + divider + table_of_contents + breadcrumb + 2 child kinds + embed + bookmark + link_preview + link_to_page + 5 media (image/video/audio/file/pdf) + table + table_row + 2 column kinds + synced_block + template + unsupported fallback. The wrapper recursively pre-decodes EVERY nested value TS-side: [RichText] (rich_text / caption), NotionColor (color), [Block] (children — RECURSIVE via dispatchedDecodeBlock), Maybe<Icon> (callout's icon), LinkTarget (link_to_page's target), NotionFile (media file), [[RichText]] (table_row's nested cells), Maybe<String> (synced_block's syncedFromBlockId). The body reads pre-decoded fields directly + constructs the typed variant via the construct op. Default arm emits UnsupportedContent with the raw type string. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeBlockContent`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:447.

notion:encodeBlockContent.label: notion-codec: encodeBlockContent
notion:encodeBlockContent.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2d — encode a BlockContent variant to the Notion wire-shape record. 33-arm case-of: each arm destructures + emits a FLAT marker record `{ _kind = "<wire_type>", ...camelCase_payload }`. The wrapper finalize switches on `_kind` + assembles the Notion wire shape `{ object: "block", type: <wire_type>, <wire_type>: { ...wire payload } }` with per-arm transformations: rich_text via dispatchedEncodeRichText (mapped), color via dispatchedEncodeColor, children via RECURSIVE dispatchedEncodeBlockContent (mapped), icon Maybe<Icon> → null|encodedIcon (CalloutContent), file/media payload assembly (5 media arms — encodeMediaPayload helper inlines NotionFile fields + caption), target via dispatchedEncodeLinkTarget (LinkToPageContent), synced_from Maybe<String> → null|{type, block_id} (SyncedBlockContent), nested cells map (TableRowContent). The marker-record approach AVOIDS the 2b `{ id = X }` codeName clash (each marker is multi-field — `_kind` + payload). DividerContent / BreadcrumbContent emit single-field `{ _kind = "..." }` — safe because `_kind` is not a std function codeName. UnsupportedContent emits `{ _kind = "unsupported" }` without round-tripping the kind string (matches TS oracle's lossy default). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeBlockContent`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:628.

notion:decodeBlock.label: notion-codec: decodeBlock
notion:decodeBlock.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2d — decode a Notion block-response record to a Block value. Flat record decoder: shuttles snake_case wire fields (id / parent / created_time / last_edited_time / created_by_user / last_edited_by_user / has_children / archived / in_trash / content) into camelCase Block constructor fields. The wrapper pre-decodes parent (via dispatchedDecodeParent), the 2 NotionUser fields (via dispatchedDecodeNotionUser), and content (via dispatchedDecodeBlockContent — RECURSIVE into the mutually-recursive blocks/content tree). Per the TS oracle, decodeBlock passes the ENTIRE wire object to decodeBlockContent (not just a sub-record — decodeBlockContent reads `v.type` to dispatch). encodeBlock is intentionally OMITTED: Notion's write API never accepts a full Block on write (writes use BlockContent directly). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeBlock`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:743.

notion:decodePage.label: notion-codec: decodePage
notion:decodePage.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2e — decode a Notion page-response record to a Page value. Flat record decoder: shuttles 13 fields from the wire shape into the Page constructor. The wrapper pre-decodes parent (via dispatchedDecodeParent), createdBy + lastEditedBy (via dispatchedDecodeNotionUser), icon + cover (via maybeDecode + dispatchedDecodeIcon / dispatchedDecodeCover), properties (via dispatchedDecodePropertiesObject), and Maybe-wraps publicUrl. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodePage`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:448.

notion:decodeDatabase.label: notion-codec: decodeDatabase
notion:decodeDatabase.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2e — decode a Notion database-response record to a Database value. Flat record decoder: shuttles 16 fields (Page shape + isInline + title + description + property schema) from the wire shape into the Database constructor. The wrapper pre-decodes the same fields as Page + maps title / description as [RichText] (via asListOf + dispatchedDecodeRichText), pre-decodes properties via dispatchedDecodePropertySchemaObject, asBool-coerces isInline. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeDatabase`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:468.

notion:decodeComment.label: notion-codec: decodeComment
notion:decodeComment.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2e — decode a Notion comment-response record to a Comment value. Flat record decoder: shuttles 7 fields (id / parent / discussion_id / created_time / last_edited_time / created_by / rich_text) into the Comment constructor. Notable: parent uses dispatchedDecodeParent (NOT dispatchedDecodeCommentParent — per types.fenel:390 Comment.parent is `Parent`, not `CommentParent`; CommentParent is write-side only for comment creation). The wrapper pre-decodes parent + createdBy (via dispatchedDecodeNotionUser) + richText (via asListOf + dispatchedDecodeRichText). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeComment`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:491.

notion:decodePaginatedList.label: notion-codec: decodePaginatedList
notion:decodePaginatedList.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2e — decode a Notion paginated-list response to a PaginatedList<a> value. Parametric over the element type: the wrapper takes a JS callback `decodeItem: (x: unknown) => unknown` + pre-decodes results TS-side via that callback before invoking the body. The body is DEGENERATE (constructs PaginatedList from pre-decoded fields). The wrapper-pre-decoding approach matches the pattern from 2c (Object.entries walk for decodePropertiesObject). The alternative — pass the element decoder as a Fenel function reference — requires marshalling a JS function into a Fenel callable, not yet validated in the codec arc. Degenerate body justified by surface-visibility consistency (matrix-tracked, Fenel-callable). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodePaginatedList`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:509.

notion:decodeSearchResult.label: notion-codec: decodeSearchResult
notion:decodeSearchResult.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2e — decode a Notion search-response record (Page or Database) to a SearchResult variant. 2-arm case-of on wire `w.object` ("database" -> DatabaseResult; default -> PageResult). The wrapper conditionally pre-decodes ONLY the matching variant (Database vs Page) to avoid wasted work. The fallback case (non-object input) decodes an empty Page in `w.page` + the body's default arm constructs PageResult from it (matches TS oracle's `PageResult { page: decodePage({}) }`). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedDecodeSearchResult`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:523.

notion:encodeTextCondition.label: notion-codec: encodeTextCondition
notion:encodeTextCondition.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a TextCondition variant to a Notion wire-shape record `{ [op]: value }` or `{ [op]: true }`. 8-arm case-of mapping each variant to a marker `{ _op = "<wire_op>", value = x }` (for variants with a value field) or `{ _op = "<wire_op>" }` (for the no-arg *IsEmpty / *IsNotEmpty variants); the wrapper's finalizeConditionWire converts the marker to the dynamic-key wire shape. Marker convention used because `contains` is a std codeName (clashes with single-field record literal dispatch). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeTextCondition`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:583 (encodeTextCondition + TEXT_OPS table).

notion:encodeNumberCondition.label: notion-codec: encodeNumberCondition
notion:encodeNumberCondition.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a NumberCondition variant to a Notion wire-shape record. 8-arm case-of with the marker-record convention. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeNumberCondition`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:584 (encodeNumberCondition + NUMBER_OPS table).

notion:encodeCheckboxCondition.label: notion-codec: encodeCheckboxCondition
notion:encodeCheckboxCondition.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a CheckboxCondition variant to a Notion wire-shape record. 2-arm case-of with the marker-record convention. The value field carries a Bool (True/False). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeCheckboxCondition`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:585 (encodeCheckboxCondition + CHECKBOX_OPS table).

notion:encodeSelectCondition.label: notion-codec: encodeSelectCondition
notion:encodeSelectCondition.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a SelectCondition variant to a Notion wire-shape record. 4-arm case-of with the marker-record convention. Reused by StatusFilter via the wrapper's wireKind dispatch (StatusFilter's condition is also a SelectCondition wire-side). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeSelectCondition`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:586 (encodeSelectCondition + SELECT_OPS table).

notion:encodeMultiSelectCondition.label: notion-codec: encodeMultiSelectCondition
notion:encodeMultiSelectCondition.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a MultiSelectCondition variant to a Notion wire-shape record. 4-arm case-of with the marker-record convention. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeMultiSelectCondition`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:587 (encodeMultiSelectCondition + MULTI_SELECT_OPS table).

notion:encodeDateCondition.label: notion-codec: encodeDateCondition
notion:encodeDateCondition.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a DateCondition variant to a Notion wire-shape record. 14-arm case-of with the marker-record convention (5 variants with value + 7 relative-date no-arg variants like past_week / next_month / this_week + 2 *IsEmpty / *IsNotEmpty). Reused by CreatedTimeFilter / LastEditedTimeFilter / TimestampFilter via the wrapper's wireKind dispatch. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeDateCondition`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:588 (encodeDateCondition + DATE_OPS table).

notion:encodePeopleCondition.label: notion-codec: encodePeopleCondition
notion:encodePeopleCondition.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a PeopleCondition variant to a Notion wire-shape record. 4-arm case-of with the marker-record convention. NOTE: PeopleContains / PeopleDoesNotContain have a `userId` field (not `value`); the body translates `userId` to `value` in the emitted marker so the shared finalizeConditionWire helper handles both PeopleCondition + the other 8 condition encoders identically. Reused by CreatedByFilter / LastEditedByFilter via the wrapper's wireKind dispatch. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodePeopleCondition`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:589 (encodePeopleCondition + PEOPLE_OPS table).

notion:encodeFilesCondition.label: notion-codec: encodeFilesCondition
notion:encodeFilesCondition.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a FilesCondition variant to a Notion wire-shape record. 2-arm case-of with the marker-record convention. Both variants are no-arg (FilesIsEmpty / FilesIsNotEmpty). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeFilesCondition`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:599 (encodeFilesCondition + FILES_OPS table).

notion:encodeRelationCondition.label: notion-codec: encodeRelationCondition
notion:encodeRelationCondition.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a RelationCondition variant to a Notion wire-shape record. 4-arm case-of with the marker-record convention. NOTE: RelationContains / RelationDoesNotContain have a `pageId` field (not `value`); same translation pattern as PeopleCondition. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeRelationCondition`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:600 (encodeRelationCondition + RELATION_OPS table).

notion:encodeFormulaCondition.label: notion-codec: encodeFormulaCondition
notion:encodeFormulaCondition.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a FormulaCondition variant to a Notion wire-shape record. 4-arm case-of dispatching on outer formula-result-type (string / checkbox / number / date) + the inner condition; emits a `{ _kind = "<outer_key>", inner = c }` marker that the wrapper finalizes by dispatching to the matching inner encoder (dispatchedEncodeTextCondition / dispatchedEncodeCheckboxCondition / dispatchedEncodeNumberCondition / dispatchedEncodeDateCondition). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeFormulaCondition`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:618.

notion:encodeRollupCondition.label: notion-codec: encodeRollupCondition
notion:encodeRollupCondition.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a RollupCondition variant to a Notion wire-shape record. 5-arm case-of: 3 compound arms (RollupAny / RollupEvery / RollupNone) contain a Filter — wrapper finalizes by recursively calling dispatchedEncodeFilter (the only place in the codec arc where recursion crosses TWO dispatched* wrappers — RollupCondition → Filter → can contain RollupFilter → RollupCondition again); 2 scalar arms (RollupNumber / RollupDate) contain a sub-condition handled like FormulaCondition. Same `{ _kind = ..., filter = f | inner = c }` marker shape as FormulaCondition. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeRollupCondition`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:633.

notion:encodeFilter.label: notion-codec: encodeFilter
notion:encodeFilter.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a Filter variant to a Notion query-database filter record. 22-arm case-of dispatching on Filter variant: AndFilter / OrFilter emit `{ _kind = "and"|"or", filters = fs }` (wrapper recursively maps each filter via dispatchedEncodeFilter — wrapper-side TS recursion same as 2d's encodeBlockContent); 19 per-property arms emit `{ _kind = "prop", property = p, wireKind = "<key>", condition = c }` (wrapper switches on wireKind to pick one of the 9 per-property condition encoders + 2 composite condition encoders); TimestampFilter emits `{ _kind = "timestamp", timestamp = t, condition = c }` (wrapper encodes timestamp via dispatchedEncodeTimestampField + uses the encoded string as BOTH the wire value AND the dynamic key for the encoded DateCondition). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeFilter`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:650.

notion:encodeSort.label: notion-codec: encodeSort
notion:encodeSort.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a Sort variant to a Notion query-database sort record. 2-arm case-of: TimestampSort emits `{ _kind = "timestamp", timestamp = t, direction = d }` (wrapper encodes timestamp via dispatchedEncodeTimestampField + direction via dispatchedEncodeSortDirection); PropertySort emits `{ _kind = "property", property = p, direction = d }` (wrapper passes property string through + encodes direction). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeSort`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:693.

notion:encodeSearchObjectFilter.label: notion-codec: encodeSearchObjectFilter
notion:encodeSearchObjectFilter.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a SearchObjectFilter variant to either a Notion search-filter wire record `{ value, property: "object" }` OR undefined (when filter is SearchAllObjects, the search handler omits the filter field entirely). 3-arm case-of: SearchOnlyPages emits `{ _kind = "page" }`; SearchOnlyDatabases emits `{ _kind = "database" }`; SearchAllObjects + catch-all emit `{ _kind = "" }` (the wrapper's `if (kind === "") return undefined;` finalize converts to JS undefined). Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeSearchObjectFilter`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:714.

notion:encodeSearchSort.label: notion-codec: encodeSearchSort
notion:encodeSearchSort.description: Phase 11b sub-step 2f — encode a SearchSort variant to a Notion search-sort wire record `{ timestamp: "last_edited_time", direction: <encoded> }`. Degenerate single-variant ADT: SearchSortByLastEdited emits `{ direction = d }` + the catch-all emits `{ direction = Ascending }` fallback; the wrapper hardcodes `timestamp: "last_edited_time"` (matching the TS oracle) + encodes the direction via dispatchedEncodeSortDirection. Boundary adapter dispatched via `dispatchedEncodeSearchSort`. Mirrors runtime/src/handlers/notion-codec.ts:726.
